established: Following and muting are personal choices; the platform still ranks the feed. Earlier part2 already explains behavioral signals.
missing: Show personally important information being missed beneath the feed; preserve the useful causal idea, remove awkward workshop/notice wording.
options: Missed news

A friend has news to share.
It slips beneath the stream.
I learn a week too late
What mattered most to me.
Shows the personal cost of a buried update: learning something important too late.
Missed gathering

The people down my street
Had plans to meet today.
Their post was in the feed.
It never came my way.
Turns unseen information into a missed chance to connect with nearby people.
Buried invitation

My sister sent a note:
‘Come hear the song I made.’
I scroll through strangers talking.
Her song gets pushed away.
Makes the missing item emotionally specific: a family invitation displaced by unrelated content.

Put the time up top.
Keep the sign-up clear.
Save the steps we settled.
Start from those next time.

Keep the format

Use the colors we chose.
Keep the type this size.
Save this page's pattern.
Use it as your guide.
Adds precise presentation instructions and saves their pattern instead of merely saving the output.
Keep the checks

List the checks we made.
Keep them with the draft.
Run them on the next page.
Keep each detail right.

options: Personal workbench

Now the shape is mine,
Built around my day.
Not a stranger's workspace
Telling me the way.
Shows accumulated choices becoming a personal working environment rather than another set of instructions.
Different ways of thinking

Yours can branch like a tree.
Mine can line up in rows.
Same tools, different patterns—
Each reflects the mind it knows.
Makes customization visible: two people can organize the same capabilities to fit different thinking styles.
A growing creation

First it was a blank page.
Now it bears my hand.
Every choice adds something
To a place I understand.
Shows authorship accumulating into a comprehensible personal creation, leading into the selected B chorus about seeds of thought.
